description: 1M1B, MeitY Startup Hub and Microsoft launch a Noida Centre to equip youth with applied AI and green skills for sustainable manufacturing, innovation and future careers.
body_lead: Noida, Uttar Pradesh, November 2, 2026: The Government of Uttar Pradesh, along with 1M1B Foundation (One Million for One Billion), MeitY Startup Hub (MSH) and Microsoft, inaugurated the Green Skills & Applied AI Centre of Excellence (CoE) at Gautam Buddha University (GBU), Noida, on November 2, 2026. The Centre will focus on equipping young people with practical skills in applied Artificial Intelligence (AI), green manufacturing, sustainability and emerging technologies, preparing them for opportunities in Uttar Pradesh’s expanding industrial and technology ecosystem.
